prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create a 1536x1024 atlas of FOUR equal 768x512 landscape paintings in a precise 2x2 grid, no gutters/borders/text. Reference 1 establishes Poppy and Willow identity and Chapter2 environment; reference 2 is the REQUIRED detailed fur and painterly texture target. Retain Poppy small cream rabbit exactly two ears one bent, plum cape rust scarf brown satchel; Willow taller grey-brown rabbit exactly two upright ears moss-green coat. Fur MUST have fine irregular tufts, visible individual strands, soft fluffy cheeks, tactile damp fur, not smooth plastic/toy/3D. Luminous detailed gouache storybook, textured timber/moss/stone, warm amber oil lamp against plum-blue rainy midnight. No readable words, map markings, clear footprints, circular evidence marks, bell, suspect, extra ears or UI. Geography: mill porch and narrow fast stream on SAME near bank, woods opposite; no lake, broad river, waterfall, bridge or village panorama. Only one oil lamp and one small handmade paper lantern per scene; paper lantern set down safely when Willow needs a paw. Panels: TOP LEFT lower mill room, stairs, crate, dented watering can, damp muddy floor without identifiable prints. Poppy grips indistinct small wet green cloth; Willow holds single glass chimney oil lamp. Handmade paper lantern on crate. No extra stair lights. TOP RIGHT atmospheric object-only lower-room view at foot of SAME stairs, same crate and watering can and paper lantern, dark empty bell hook subtle, no rabbits. BOTTOM LEFT upper loft, sloping timber roof, dusty sacks, open wooden chest at rainy window; Poppy near chest, Willow holds oil lamp, paper lantern set beside sacks; conceal chest bottom with angle and shadow. BOTTOM RIGHT same loft window, Poppy cups paws to glass looking outside; Willow behind holds oil lamp; dark wet branches outside without suspect, same paper lantern resting beside sacks.
